name: National Flood Hazard Layer · North Cove
usedFor: Current mapped special flood hazard polygons near North Cove.
notes: The approximate plant point lies in mapped Zone X. Nearby Zone AE polygons show the river corridor. Current regulatory boundaries are excluded from the historical trigger.

name: Drug Establishments Current Registration
usedFor: Current establishment FEI identifiers, addresses and registration operations.
notes: 43 FDA labels are parsed for supplier statements and matched with rapidfuzz against 40 relevant registration rows. City evidence is required for accepted candidates. Historical plant links remain curated.

name: Hospital locations · archived HIFLD snapshot
license: Public-domain US government data; mirror has no additional restrictions
usedFor: 7,105 historical facility locations, names and available bed counts.
notes: The mirror was last updated in 2018. Specialty facilities are included. This is not a current national hospital census. Rurality, safety-net status, system size and pediatric classification are explicit proxies.

name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022
usedFor: County RPL_THEMES percentile joined to HIFLD county FIPS.
notes: 3,144 measured ranks. Missing county values use 0.5 and are marked imputed. Puerto Rico ranks use the fallback. Current boundary definitions differ from the hospital snapshot.

name: FEMA National Risk Index county scores
usedFor: Hurricane, inland-flood and tornado risk scores for 3,232 county records.
notes: Layer version retrieved on the listed date. IFLD is the current inland-flood score used in the riverine-risk UI. Scores are relative ranks, not event probabilities.

name: NHC advisory forecast GIS archives
usedFor: Helene AL092024 advisories 1–18 and Maria AL152017 advisories 1–25, including forecast points and cone polygons.
notes: Cones retain issued timestamps and are simplified for drawing. These are official forecast cones. Initial forecast position time is displayed at advisory issue time.

name: Atlantic hurricane database HURDAT2
usedFor: Retrospective best-track positions, intensity, pressure and available wind radii.
notes: Best track is retrospective analysis for replay verification. It is excluded from alert scoring. Missing radius of maximum wind uses a model assumption.

name: Hurricane Helene tropical cyclone report
usedFor: Helene landfall on 27 September 2024 at 03:10 UTC and rainfall forecast chronology.
notes: Event verification only. This post-event report is excluded from alert inputs.

name: Hurricane Maria tropical cyclone report
usedFor: Maria crossed Puerto Rico near Yabucoa at approximately 10:15 UTC on 20 September 2017.
notes: Landfall is the disruption reference. Exact manufacturing shutdown times are unavailable.

name: Archived WPC and SPC outlook polygons
license: Public-domain NOAA products; IEM archive access
usedFor: Issue-dated WPC rainfall and SPC tornado outlooks.
notes: North Cove enters the WPC High Risk polygon in the September 25, 2024 19:31 UTC issue. Earlier High Risk areas cover other parts of the region.

name: SPC historical tornado database
usedFor: Rocky Mount EF3 tornado start/end coordinates, width and path length.
notes: The stored straight line connects official survey endpoints. The complete curved damage-survey footprint is not represented. SPC length is 13.53 mi; initial NWS summary reported 16.5 mi.

name: July 2023 Central NC climate summary
usedFor: 19 July EF3 tornado occurred from 12:25–12:58 EDT and damaged a pharmaceutical facility.
notes: The exact time the warehouse was struck is unavailable. This case has no validated pre-event plant alert.

name: Catawba River near Pleasant Gardens · 02137727
usedFor: Archived 15-minute stream stage for the Helene period.
notes: A regional main-stem gauge near Marion. This is not a measurement of inundation inside the Baxter plant. No unverified flood-stage threshold is imposed.

name: Historical NEXRAD composites
license: Public-domain NOAA observations; IEM archive access
usedFor: Timestamped regional radar images for the three replays.
notes: Tiles are cached locally. Regional radar is shown at its available timestamp. Coverage gaps are retained.

name: MODIS daily satellite composites
license: NASA Earth science data freely available with attribution
usedFor: Local satellite composites for the replay dates.
notes: Daily composites are retrospective imagery. A frame becomes visible only after its UTC date completes and is excluded from alert scoring.

name: Blue Marble Earth texture
license: NASA imagery usage guidelines; attribution provided
usedFor: Globe intro Earth surface texture.
notes: This 2002 image is decorative context and has no forecast role.

name: Earth cloud texture
usedFor: Intro cloud animation.
notes: Resized, reprojected and recolored from the original texture. Clouds are illustrative.

name: Natural Earth geographic vectors
usedFor: Offline coastlines and borders.
notes: Geographic display only.

name: US atlas county and state geometry
usedFor: Offline US boundaries.
notes: County geometries and current vulnerability records may use different vintages.

name: openFDA Drug Shortages API
license: CC0 for openFDA data, with FDA terms and caveats
usedFor: 1,598 presentation records in the 2026-11-06 snapshot. FDA posting-family benchmark and observed shortage flags.
notes: Current and resolved listings form an incomplete history. Withdrawn resolved records and never-listed products are missing. This limits training and validation.

name: openFDA label and NDC directories
license: FDA public labeling data; underlying labels may contain manufacturer copyright
usedFor: Supplier extraction from public labels and current labeler counts.
notes: Labeler names do not establish manufacturing locations or historical market shares. Site mappings require independent manufacturer evidence.

name: Baxter North Cove IV-supply disruption
usedFor: Published estimate of approximately 60% of US IV solutions from North Cove.
notes: The overall 60% estimate is not a verified market share for every drug. Product-specific shares in the simulation are assumptions.

name: Baxter third-quarter 2024 results
usedFor: Confirms the North Cove plant flooding and shutdown on September 27, 2024.
notes: The calendar date is verified. Local midnight is used only as a conservative timing reference because the inundation hour is unpublished.

name: Baxter allocation update effective October 9
usedFor: Date of increased allocation for highest-demand IV fluids.
notes: Highest-demand direct-customer and distributor allocations rose to 60%. Designated children’s hospitals received 100% allocations for relevant products.

name: FDA Roundup · October 11, 2024
usedFor: Dated FDA assessment of inadequate supply for certain IV and PD products.
notes: Shown as a publication event. It is not asserted to be the initial shortage-listing time for every product.

name: Rocky Mount emergency-order product list
usedFor: Verified Rocky Mount links for sodium bicarbonate, atropine, dobutamine and potassium phosphates.
notes: Restricted presentations are specific NDCs. The demo aggregates presentation families and assigns illustrative shares.

name: Pfizer post-tornado facility update
usedFor: Warehouse damage and facility disruption following the July 19, 2023 tornado.
notes: Pfizer reported the primary damage in the warehouse. Initial assessment did not show major damage to medicine-production areas.

name: Baxter Puerto Rico recovery update
usedFor: Puerto Rico small-volume parenteral production and post-Maria recovery.
notes: Small-volume IV bags are the Maria focus. Exact allocation of products to Jayuya versus other Puerto Rico sites is uncertain and the site link is a representative mapping.

name: FDA congressional testimony · October 24, 2017
usedFor: Maria worsened pre-existing IV-solution shortages and prompted importation.
notes: This corrects the claim that Maria alone initiated all national IV-bag shortages.

name: B. Braun supply update after Helene and Milton
license: Copyright B. Braun; linked factual summary
usedFor: Irvine and Daytona Beach IV-solution production sites.
notes: Site product shares and specific drug-family assignments are illustrative.

name: ASHP record active shortages in 2024
usedFor: 323 active US drug shortages in Q1 2024.
notes: The statistic counts active shortages and differs from new shortage counts and the FDA definition.

name: ASHP 2024 annual shortage report
usedFor: Historical active-shortage series for 2022–2024.
notes: Selected periods are displayed with their period labels in the source data.

name: Pharmacy supply assurance report
usedFor: 2019 member-survey estimate of $359 million annual US hospital shortage-management labor costs.
notes: A historic national estimate, separate from simulated savings in this app.

name: Small- and large-volume fluid conservation
usedFor: Pharmacist review prompts for clinically appropriate oral hydration and fluid conservation.
notes: November 25, 2024 update is present-day reference guidance. It is excluded from the pre-event alert inputs. Local protocol and patient eligibility require review.

name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines · 2023
usedFor: Selected essential-medicine badges.
notes: Badge confirms a listed medicine/form. Absence of a badge does not imply absence from the WHO list.

name: NOAA annual US climate assessments
usedFor: Annual billion-dollar disaster counts for 2022–2024.
notes: Inflation-adjusted event classification differs from the drug-shortage definition. This descriptive comparison supports no causal estimate.

name: NHC cone definition and forecast errors
usedFor: Error-radius assumptions used by the interactive storm ensemble.
notes: A drawn storm uses the 2026 generic cone-error table. This is an illustrative scenario and does not recreate the complete operational NHC probabilistic system.

name: Current tropical cyclone feed
usedFor: Runtime active storm feed with timestamped local cache.
notes: The live panel identifies cache age.

name: National Weather Service active alerts
usedFor: Runtime alerts with timestamped local cache.
notes: The live panel identifies cache age.

name: Storm Prediction Center outlooks
usedFor: SPC outlook references for current operations.
notes: Live outlook availability depends on the upstream service.

name: Rx Radar planning assumptions
usedFor: Inventories, per-product shares, distributor links, site recovery, prices, hoarding policies, clinical workload, emissions and impact factors.
notes: All are scenario assumptions. No purchasing, patient or private hospital inventory data are used. Fair allocation is an aggregate simulation requiring pharmacist approval.

name: National Average Drug Acquisition Cost
usedFor: Reference only; price coverage was not established for the modeled inpatient presentations.
notes: Displayed contract prices and gray-market multipliers are simulated. NADAC is not used in the risk benchmark.
